entities.name: Ghostfire
entities.description: Invisible colorless flame created by Ugin, used against the Eldrazi, key to activating the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon who created ghostfire and taught it to the Jeskai.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Dragonlord who agreed to the bargain.

entities.name: Khanfall
entities.description: Event after which Shu Yun made a bargain.

events.summary: After the Khanfall, Shu Yun bargains with Ojutai that all Ghostfire Warriors die so the Jeskai may live.
events.quote: Shu Yun made a bargain with Ojutai that all the Ghostfire Warriors would die

events.summary: Chandra Nalaar steals the Dragon Scroll from the Sanctum of Stars.
events.quote: the Dragon Scroll that Chandra Nalaar stole from the Sanctum of Stars on Kephalai

relations.quote: Ugin created ghostfire, and considers it his greatest creation.
